rationale.complete: Round 1 done: pre-registration, synthetic validation at the real design (with measured reliability), 17 per-period verdicts, rivals, robustness, post hoc checks and a dry-run confirm script. Holdout, an embedding swap and an hour-scale design are missing; the direction is low priority. Round 1b: work-ledger outcome, fixed activity bins, both embedding models x three dedups, natives G51 (rival pairs, roles), G39, G42.
rationale.faithfulness: The core prediction failed. No inverted U (both slopes n.s.); PR10 does not beat FE + controls in day-blocked CV (C = 0); 0/14 periods supported, and the meta right slope has the wrong sign. The test had about 80% power for a 0.4-SD inverted U, so this is a fairly well-understood null, not just an untested one.
rationale.usefulness: A negative result about a plausible operator metric: within-agent daily content diversity is not a lever or monitor for output, with a computed bound (at most about 9% fewer write turns at the 90th percentile vs the best). It retires a dashboard idea but offers no knob.

one_line: No diversity-productivity optimum, in write turns or in work commits that landed; the only right-side drop is a #51 tail effect seen by one embedding model.

v2.claim: No diversity–productivity optimum on committed work; the #51 tail is model-dependent
v2.scope: 12 periods, 1,290 agent-days; natives G51, G39, G42
